name: 5 Amino 1 MQ
description:
Disclaimer: This product is for research use only (RUO). Not intended for human or animal consumption and not approved for clinical or therapeutic use.

5-Amino-1MQ is a synthetic small-molecule compound developed for research and laboratory studies. It is designed to selectively target the NNMT enzyme (nicotinamide N-methyltransferase), enabling controlled investigations into metabolic pathways, fat metabolism, and cellular energy regulation.

Description 5-Amino-1MQ is a research-grade small molecule used in preclinical studies to explore: • NNMT inhibition and downstream metabolic effects • NAD+ modulation and mitochondrial function • Fat oxidation and cellular energy production • Experimental pathways related to obesity, longevity, and body composition The compound is supplied as capsules, tablets, or lyophilized powder, facilitating reproducible dosing in laboratory settings. It enables researchers to study metabolic processes, tissue-level responses, and molecular signaling without therapeutic claims.

Dosage/Form 50 mg per capsule or vial; available as capsules/tablets or freeze-dried powder

Purity ≥99% verified by HPLC; additional testing includes endotoxins, sterility, weight verification (~58.35 mg per vial), and TFA content

Solubility Water, DMSO, or ethanol; pH 6.5–7.5 (1 mg/mL in H₂O)

Packaging Sterile, sealed vials or bottles (e.g., 60 capsules) with tamper-evident caps for laboratory safety

Energy Metabolism Enhanced fat oxidation and energy metabolism in preclinical models

Muscle Preservation Preservation of muscle mass during metabolic stress

Mitochondrial Function Increased NAD+ levels in fat cells and improved mitochondrial function

Metabolic Applications Applications in experimental weight management, body composition, and aging pathways

All batches are third-party verified for purity and quality. Research use is limited to in vitro and preclinical studies, and the compound is not approved for clinical, therapeutic, or human use.

name: AOD-9604
description:
AOD-9604 is a synthetic peptide fragment (derived from the C-terminal of human growth hormone) primarily studied for obesity management and weight loss . It works by accelerating fat breakdown (lipolysis) and inhibiting fat formation (lipogenesis) without causing the adverse blood sugar or growth hormone side effects associated with full-length human growth hormone.

Key research and potential uses for AOD-9604 include:

researchAreas.title: Fat Loss and Weight Management
researchAreas.body: Studies indicate it specifically targets abdominal and visceral adipose tissue, promoting the metabolism of fat for energy. It is often described as a, "[Fat-Burning HGH Fragment]" according to Perfect B .

researchAreas.title: Osteoarthritis Support
researchAreas.body: Research has explored its potential benefits in repairing cartilage and supporting joint health, notes Paragon Sports Medicine .

researchAreas.title: Metabolic Improvement
researchAreas.body: It is designed to assist in reducing obesity while maintaining favorable blood sugar levels.

researchAreas.title: Alternative to Hormone Therapy
researchAreas.body: Because it does not raise IGF-1 levels or trigger the same side effects as full human growth hormone, it has been studied as a safer alternative for metabolic regulation, explains BHR Center .

name: AOD-9604 Spray
description: Each spray delivers 50mcg. Easy and convenient option for your research.

name: ARA-290
description: ARA-290 (cibinetide) is primarily being studied as a therapeutic peptide to treat chronic neuropathic pain associated with sarcoidosis and diabetic neuropathy, often targeting small fiber neuropathy (SFN). It operates by activating the innate repair receptor (IRR) to reduce inflammation, promote tissue repair, and provide pain relief without affecting red blood cell production

researchAreas.title: Small Fiber Neuropathy (SFN) and Sarcoidosis
researchAreas.body: Evaluated for reducing neuropathic symptoms, pain, and numbness in patients with sarcoidosis.

researchAreas.title: Diabetic Neuropathy
researchAreas.body: Investigated for relieving pain and improving corneal nerve fiber density in diabetic patients.

researchAreas.title: Diabetic Macular Edema (DMO)
researchAreas.body: Studied as a potential treatment for vision improvement in diabetes patients.

researchAreas.title: Inflammatory/Tissue Repair Conditions
researchAreas.body: Researched for its ability to reduce renal inflammation and protect against kidney injury. (PubMed Central (PMC) (.gov)

name: BPC-157
description: BPC-157 is a synthetic peptide derived from gastric juices, extensively studied in preclinical models for its regenerative, anti-inflammatory, and angiogenic (blood vessel growth) properties . Research focuses on treating musculoskeletal injuries (tendons, ligaments, bones), inflammatory bowel disease, gastrointestinal ulcers, and accelerating wound healing.

researchAreas.title: Musculoskeletal Regeneration
researchAreas.body: Studied for accelerating the healing of injured muscles, tendons, ligaments, and bone, specifically tendon-to-bone reconnection.

researchAreas.title: Gastrointestinal Health
researchAreas.body: Originally investigated for its role in stomach lining protection, it is studied for treating inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) and gastric ulcers.

researchAreas.title: Angiogenesis & Wound Healing
researchAreas.body: Research shows it promotes blood vessel formation and collagen production, leading to faster skin wound and burn repair.

researchAreas.title: Systemic Anti-inflammatory Effects
researchAreas.body: Investigated for reducing inflammation and oxidative stress across various tissues, including potential neuroprotective effects for stroke or traumatic brain injury.

researchAreas.title: Organ Protection
researchAreas.body: Studies indicate protective effects on the liver, pancreas, and heart.

researchAreas.title: Drug Antagonist
researchAreas.body: Researched for its ability to counteract adverse effects of certain medications (e.g., NSAID damage) and substance toxicity.

name: BPC-157 Capsules
description: BPC-157 is a synthetic pentadecapeptide composed of 15 amino acids, partially derived from the body protection compound found in human gastric juice. This peptide demonstrates remarkable stability and exhibits pleiotropic effects throughout various tissue systems. Mechanistically, BPC-157 appears to modulate the nitric oxide (NO) pathway, interact with growth hormone receptors, and influence several molecular pathways involved in angiogenesis, fibroblast migration, and collagen deposition

name: DSIP Spray
description: Delta Sleep-Inducing Peptide (DSIP) is primarily studied for its potential to improve sleep quality, induce delta-wave sleep, and treat chronic insomnia . Research also investigates its role in regulating stress (by managing cortisol), reducing pain, enhancing cognitive function, and treating withdrawal syndromes.

Key research areas include improving skin elasticity, reducing wrinkles, accelerating wound healing, stimulating hair growth, and potentially reversing cellular aging.

See the links below for some current available studies.

Key research areas include skin rejuvenation, improving hair growth, enhancing wound healing in tissues, and potential therapeutic applications for lung diseases and cognitive decline.

name: Glutathione
description: Glutathione is extensively studied as a potent antioxidant and therapeutic agent to combat oxidative stress in chronic diseases, neurodegeneration, and liver conditions . Key research areas include treating Parkinson’s, Alzheimer’s, fatty liver disease, cystic fibrosis, and reducing inflammation in autoimmune disorders.

KPV (Lys-Pro-Val) is a tripeptide derived from α-melanocyte-stimulating hormone (α-MSH) that is primarily being studied for its potent anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and wound-healing properties . It is considered a promising therapeutic candidate for chronic inflammatory conditions, particularly those affecting the gastrointestinal tract and skin, due to its ability to modulate immune responses without broad immunosuppression.

name: Methylene Blue
description: Methylene blue is a synthetic compound used as both a vibrant dye (in histology/textiles) and a medical drug . It is FDA-approved to treat methemoglobinemia (a blood disorder) and acts as an antioxidant that enhances mitochondrial efficiency, leading to its, often unregulated, use as a cognitive-boosting "nootropic" supplement.

name: MK-677 Capsules
description: MK-677 (Ibutamoren) is an investigational, non-peptide growth hormone (GH) secretagogue being studied to treat growth hormone deficiencies, sarcopenia (muscle wasting) in the elderly, and frailty. It stimulates GH and IGF-1 production to increase lean muscle mass, improve bone density, treat catabolic states, and improve sleep quality.

name: MOTS-C
description: MOTS-c (mitochondrial open reading frame of the 12S rRNA-c) is a mitochondrial-derived peptide being heavily studied for its role in regulating metabolism, enhancing insulin sensitivity, and promoting longevity . Research focuses on its potential to reverse age- and diet-dependent insulin resistance, combat obesity, improve physical performance/exercise capacity, and reduce age-related metabolic decline.

researchAreas.title: Metabolic Disease and Diabetes
researchAreas.body: MOTS-c increases glucose clearance, acts as an exercise-induced hormone, and has shown promise in reducing obesity and insulin resistance in high-fat diet mouse models.

researchAreas.title: Aging and Longevity
researchAreas.body: Studies indicate MOTS-c levels decline with age and that supplementation can restore metabolic homeostasis and protect against age-related decline.

researchAreas.title: Physical Performance and Muscle Function
researchAreas.body: Research has shown that MOTS-c treatment can double running capacity in mice and enhance skeletal muscle metabolism. It is being investigated to increase muscle mass and exercise capacity.

researchAreas.title: Cardiovascular Protection
researchAreas.body: Studies suggest MOTS-c protects against coronary endothelial cell dysfunction by reducing oxidative stress and inhibiting inflammation.

researchAreas.title: Bone Metabolism
researchAreas.body: Research has shown it promotes osteogenic differentiation and protects bone mass.

researchAreas.title: Neuroprotection
researchAreas.body: Research shows MOTS-c may reduce neuroinflammation, improve memory recognition, and combat memory deficits.

name: MT II
description: Melanotan II (MT-2) is a synthetic peptide analog of a -melanocyte-stimulating hormone (a-MSH) primarily studied for inducing skin tanning, protecting against UV-induced skin damage, and treating sexual dysfunction. Research also explores its potential for appetite regulation, weight loss, and treating neurodegenerative conditions, though it is not FDA-approved and carries significant safety concerns.

name: NAD+
description: NAD+ (nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide) is being heavily studied for its potential to reverse cellular aging, boost metabolism, and treat age-related diseases . Research focuses on restoring declining NAD+ levels to enhance DNA repair, improve mitochondrial function, reduce neuroinflammation, and support cardiovascular health, primarily using precursors like NMN and NR.

researchAreas.title: Anti-Aging and Longevity
researchAreas.body: Studies explore how NAD+ activates sirtuins and PARPs, enzymes that repair DNA and regulate cellular health, essentially delaying the hallmarks of aging.

researchAreas.title: Neurodegenerative Diseases
researchAreas.body: Research suggests NAD+ can protect against Alzheimer's by reducing neuroinflammation, lowering beta-amyloid levels, and improving cognitive function.

researchAreas.title: Metabolic Disorders
researchAreas.body: NAD+ is studied for treating obesity, type 2 diabetes, and fatty liver disease by improving insulin sensitivity and enhancing mitochondrial energy production.

researchAreas.title: Cardiovascular Health
researchAreas.body: Studies investigate its role in lowering blood pressure, reducing arterial stiffness, and protecting against heart failure.

researchAreas.title: COVID-19 and Immune Support
researchAreas.body: Research examines if boosting NAD+ can combat inflammation (cytokine storms) and support immune responses.

researchAreas.title: Addiction and Fatigue
researchAreas.body: Emerging research suggests NAD+ may assist in reducing cravings for substances and managing chronic fatigue.

NAD+ (nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide) is a vital coenzyme found in all living cells, essential for energy production, DNA repair, and cellular maintenance . Because natural NAD+ levels decline with age, it is a major area of research in medicine and longevity.

Major areas of clinical and preclinical research include:

name: Oxytocin Spray
description:
Oxytocin 5mg spray provides flexibility in your research delivery options. Each spray is 50mcg.

Oxytocin is being studied as a therapeutic agent for various psychiatric, neurological, and social disorders due to its role in bonding, stress regulation, and social behavior. Major research areas include intranasal applications for autism spectrum disorder , social anxiety , post-traumatic stress disorder (PTSD), depression, schizophrenia, and binge eating disorders.

name: Pinealon
description: Pinealon (Glu-Asp-Arg) is a synthetic tripeptide studied primarily for its neuroprotective , cognitive-enhancing , and anti-aging effects on the central nervous system . It is researched to improve memory, attention, and mental performance in the elderly, as well as to combat age-related brain dysfunction, oxidative stress, and neuronal damage

researchAreas.title: Neuroprotection & Cognitive Enhancement
researchAreas.body: Studies indicate Pinealon can reduce neuronal apoptosis (cell death) and improve memory, attention, and cognitive function, particularly in older individuals. It is often explored for its potential to slow cognitive decline.

researchAreas.title: Brain Cell Resilience
researchAreas.body: Research suggests Pinealon increases brain neuron resistance to hypoxia (low oxygen) and minimizes damage from excitotoxicity. It is studied for its ability to reduce reactive oxygen species (ROS) and support neuron survival, say sources like Biotech Peptides and PubMed .

researchAreas.title: Anti-Aging & Gene Expression
researchAreas.body: Pinealon is studied as a "geroprotector," aimed at reducing the rate of aging in patients with organic brain syndrome. It may improve the expression of genes related to brain protein synthesis.

researchAreas.title: Sleep & Mood Regulation
researchAreas.body: Studies have suggested Pinealon can help manage shift work disorder, improve sleep quality (including REM sleep), and treat seasonal affective disorder.

researchAreas.title: Mechanism of Action
researchAreas.body: It is believed to act on the central nervous system by promoting gene expression, which helps regulate protein production and enhance synaptic plasticity. National Institutes of Health (.gov) +6

name: PT-141
description: PT-141 (Bremelanotide) is primarily studied and used to treat sexual dysfunction by acting directly on the central nervous system to increase sexual desire. It is FDA-approved for treating acquired, generalized Hypoactive Sexual Desire Disorder (HSDD) in premenopausal women and is studied for treating erectile dysfunction and low libido in men

researchAreas.title: Hypoactive Sexual Desire Disorder (HSDD)
researchAreas.body: Evaluated for treating low sexual desire not caused by medical/mental health conditions, relationship issues, or drugs.

researchAreas.title: Erectile Dysfunction (ED)
researchAreas.body: Studied as a treatment for men who fail to respond to PDE5 inhibitors (like Viagra), as PT-141 works through the nervous system, not just blood flow.

researchAreas.title: Female Sexual Arousal Disorder
researchAreas.body: Targeted to help with desire and arousal issues.

researchAreas.title: Mechanism of Action
researchAreas.body: Research focuses on its role as a melanocortin receptor agonist (specifically MC4R), which initiates sexual desire in the brain.

name: SELANK
description: Selank is a synthetic regulatory peptide primarily studied for its potent anxiolytic (anti-anxiety) , antistress , and nootropic (cognitive-enhancing) effects , often acting without the sedative or addictive side effects of benzodiazepines. It is heavily researched for managing Generalized Anxiety Disorder (GAD), neurasthenia , cognitive improvement , and immune modulation .

name: Semax Spray
description:
Semax 5mg spray allows for flexibility of delivery in your research. Each spray is 50mcg.

Semax is a synthetic peptide studied primarily for its neuroprotective , cognitive-enhancing , and nootropic properties . Key areas of research include accelerating stroke recovery, treating Alzheimer’s /Parkinson’s disease, reversing cognitive decline , enhancing memory/focus, reducing anxiety/depression , and facilitating rehabilitation after traumatic brain injuries.

name: SLU-PP-332 CAPSULES
description: SLU-PP-332 is an experimental drug being studied as an "exercise mimetic" to treat metabolic diseases, primarily obesity, diabetes, and related conditions . It acts as an estrogen receptor-related orphan receptor (ERR) agonist, forcing the body to burn more fat and increase energy expenditure as if it were performing high-intensity exercise.

researchAreas.title: Obesity and Weight Management
researchAreas.body: Studies show it can reduce fat mass in mice by over 10 times without altering food intake or requiring physical training.

researchAreas.title: Metabolic Health
researchAreas.body: It improves insulin sensitivity and reduces fat accumulation, showing promise for treating metabolic syndrome.

researchAreas.title: Muscle and Endurance Boost
researchAreas.body: It increases mitochondrial function and oxidative fibers in skeletal muscle, improving endurance.

researchAreas.title: Cardioprotection
researchAreas.body: Research points to potential benefits in treating heart failure and protecting against kidney dysfunction.

name: TB-500
description: TB-500 is a synthetic peptide (fragment of Thymosin β-4) primarily studied for its potential to accelerate healing, reduce inflammation, and promote tissue regeneration in muscles, ligaments, tendons, and skin . Research focuses on its role in stimulating actin to repair soft tissue, aiding injury recovery, reducing scar tissue, and enhancing angiogenesis (blood vessel formation).
